scope: Local, non-generative professional image-editing workflows for current Arch Linux, Wayland, and Omarchy Quattro. Cloud services and proprietary implementation claims are outside scope.

statusDefinitions.Complete: Acceptance recipe and all applicable automated, fixture, undo, persistence, and budget evidence exist.
statusDefinitions.Partial: A usable local slice exists, but its listed acceptance or evidence is incomplete.
statusDefinitions.Planned: In product scope but not yet implemented; no completion is implied.
statusDefinitions.Excluded: Intentionally outside the product boundary with a recorded reason.
statusDefinitions.Blocked: Cannot proceed until a named decision or external prerequisite is resolved.

capabilities.title: Native Wayland workspace
capabilities.acceptance: Launch a dockable native workspace on Wayland and restore its layout.
capabilities.budget: Cold start <= 2 s; idle RSS <= 250 MiB target
capabilities.limits: Real Omarchy, settings, HiDPI, and accessibility evidence missing.

capabilities.title: Omarchy manifest and detached launcher contract
capabilities.acceptance: Parse the root manifest and prove the shell-detached helper reports missing and early-exiting native binaries.
capabilities.budget: Launcher returns immediately; helper owns and reaps the native child
capabilities.limits: Found-but-nonexecutable and nonzero-exit diagnostics are implemented; live Omarchy reload evidence remains separate.

capabilities.title: Native launch failure diagnostics
capabilities.acceptance: Report missing, found-but-unlaunchable, and early/nonzero native exits without swallowing the exit status.
capabilities.budget: No polling; one helper and native process per launch
capabilities.limits: Missing/early-exit paths are automated; permission-denied and live desktop notification evidence are incomplete.

capabilities.title: Live Omarchy menu launch and reload survival
capabilities.acceptance: Install root plugin, launch, reload Quickshell, and verify editor PID survives.
capabilities.budget: Launch <= 2 s; zero shell-owned editor processes

capabilities.title: Safe native single-instance activation
capabilities.acceptance: Second launch activates the first process and forwards files without data loss.

capabilities.title: Settings and workspace persistence
capabilities.acceptance: Persist, reset, export, and restore local settings and panel layouts.
capabilities.limits: No settings schema or migration yet.

capabilities.title: Configurable keyboard shortcuts
capabilities.acceptance: Detect conflicts, edit shortcuts, reset defaults, and persist changes.

capabilities.title: Offline operation without telemetry
capabilities.acceptance: Run core workflows with networking disabled and observe no connection attempts.

capabilities.title: Exact-SHA Arch package build and install
capabilities.acceptance: Build/check/install an unprivileged checksummed source archive whose version matches the checked-out SHA.
capabilities.limits: Exact source and execution image/action are pinned; rolling Arch repository dependencies are not snapshot-pinned, so this is not a reproducible-release claim.

capabilities.title: Typed checked pixel, channel, and alpha contracts
capabilities.acceptance: Reject incompatible channel/alpha formats and convert explicitly at boundaries.
capabilities.limits: Current storage is QImage RGBA premultiplied only.

capabilities.title: Sparse tile copy-on-write storage
capabilities.acceptance: Copy documents without duplicating pixel payloads, detach only the mutated tile, and measure container metadata separately.
capabilities.budget: 256x256 pixel payload per detached tile; container/hash metadata is measured but not hard-bounded
capabilities.limits: Qt implicit sharing covers pixel payloads; allocator/container overhead and one RGBA8 premultiplied pixel type remain incomplete.

capabilities.title: Bounded cache, scratch, and job system
capabilities.acceptance: Cancel jobs and enforce cache, scratch, concurrency, and low-memory limits.
capabilities.limits: No shared job scheduler or scratch allocator.

capabilities.title: Partial render DAG
capabilities.acceptance: Invalidate only affected nodes/tiles and produce deterministic dependency ordering.
capabilities.budget: Work proportional to dirty visible tiles
capabilities.limits: Current layer composite is direct source-over.

capabilities.title: Deterministic CPU reference composite
capabilities.acceptance: Composite visible source-over layers deterministically with opacity against original/public vectors and full-image goldens.
capabilities.limits: Basic behavior is tested; independent edge-alpha, tile-boundary, ordering, opacity, and repeatability goldens are incomplete.

capabilities.title: Viewport-bounded huge sparse rendering
capabilities.acceptance: Paint a sparse 300k-square document at minimum zoom without full-frame allocation.
capabilities.limits: No persistent mip pyramid or GPU path.

capabilities.title: Reversible delta and coalesced commands
capabilities.acceptance: Store reversible operation deltas, coalesce strokes, and preserve strict budgets.

capabilities.title: Post-cursor history estimate
capabilities.acceptance: Conservatively estimate retained command heap and shared pixel payload after execute, undo, and redo, evicting redo safely.
capabilities.budget: Configured command count is hard; byte accounting is an estimate
capabilities.limits: Qt/container allocator capacity and object overhead are not fully observable, so this is not a strict heap bound.

capabilities.title: Chunked versioned native persistence
capabilities.acceptance: Skip known-safe chunks, migrate versions, stream data, and reject invalid lengths.
capabilities.budget: Bounded chunk allocation and linear streaming
capabilities.limits: Current v2 format is versioned but monolithic.

capabilities.title: Crash journal and recovery
capabilities.acceptance: Recover committed edits after crash without overwriting the source.
capabilities.limits: No journal, low-disk, or cancel-safe recovery yet.

capabilities.title: Create raster document
capabilities.acceptance: Create validated dimensions and initial pixels from dialog presets.
capabilities.budget: Dimensions <= 300k per axis; sparse initial storage
capabilities.limits: No background presets, templates, or undo boundary.

capabilities.title: Create and paste from clipboard
capabilities.acceptance: Create a document or paste a layer from bounded local clipboard raster data with undo and color/alpha fixtures.
capabilities.budget: Reject clipboard payloads above decoded pixel and byte caps before document allocation
capabilities.limits: Not implemented; clipboard ownership changes and unsupported MIME types need tests.

capabilities.title: Place local raster/vector asset
capabilities.acceptance: Place a supported local asset as embedded or linked content with transform, relink, undo, and persistence.
capabilities.budget: Decode and embedded payload quotas are explicit and cancelable
capabilities.limits: Not implemented; no implicit network resolution.

capabilities.title: Multiple tabs and save prompts
capabilities.acceptance: Open several documents and correctly save/discard/cancel per tab and on exit.
capabilities.limits: Prompt lifecycle integration and saved revision tracking missing.

capabilities.title: Recent documents
capabilities.acceptance: Maintain bounded local recents with missing-file removal and privacy clear.

capabilities.title: Resize image
capabilities.acceptance: Resize with explicit resampler, aspect rules, undo, and golden output.

capabilities.title: Resize canvas
capabilities.acceptance: Change canvas anchor/background without resampling layer pixels.
capabilities.budget: Metadata-only where tiles remain in bounds

capabilities.title: Rotate and flip image
capabilities.acceptance: Apply right-angle/free rotation and flips with undo and goldens.
capabilities.limits: View rotation and image rotation both absent.

capabilities.title: Zoom and pan canvas
capabilities.acceptance: Zoom within bounds, pan by mouse/keyboard, and preserve focus/anchor.
capabilities.limits: No gestures, pixel grid, navigator, or live Wayland latency evidence.

capabilities.title: Rotate view non-destructively
capabilities.acceptance: Rotate/reset view without changing document pixels.

capabilities.title: Rulers and guides
capabilities.acceptance: Create, move, lock, hide, persist, and remove guides in chosen units.

capabilities.title: Grid, pixel grid, and snapping
capabilities.acceptance: Configure grid and snap tools/transforms to enabled targets.

capabilities.title: Navigator panel
capabilities.acceptance: Show bounded preview, viewport outline, zoom control, and drag navigation.

capabilities.title: File menu workflows
capabilities.acceptance: Exercise New, Open, Open Recent, Close, Save, Save As, Export, Print, and Quit including disabled/error states.
capabilities.limits: Recents, print, and complete lifecycle integration are missing.

capabilities.title: Edit menu workflows
capabilities.acceptance: Exercise Undo, Redo, preferences/settings, shortcuts, and command labels/enabled states.
capabilities.limits: Preferences and shortcut editor are missing.

capabilities.title: Image menu workflows
capabilities.acceptance: Exercise image size, canvas size, rotate, flip, mode/depth, and profile commands with correct enablement.
capabilities.limits: Image menu workflows are not implemented.

capabilities.title: Layer menu workflows
capabilities.acceptance: Exercise create, group, duplicate, delete, reorder, properties, masks, merge, and flatten with correct enablement.
capabilities.limits: Groups, multi-select, masks, and full enablement tests are missing.

capabilities.title: Select menu workflows
capabilities.acceptance: Exercise all, none, invert, geometric/color selections, modify, save/load channel, and no-op states.
capabilities.limits: Only all, deselect, invert, and canvas rectangle slices exist.

capabilities.title: View menu workflows
capabilities.acceptance: Exercise zoom, fit, actual pixels, rotate view, rulers, guides, grid, snapping, and display toggles.
capabilities.limits: Rotation, rulers, guides, grid, snapping, and pixel grid are missing.

capabilities.title: Window menu and panel visibility workflows
capabilities.acceptance: Show/hide/focus every panel, reset workspace, and navigate documents by keyboard.
capabilities.limits: No complete Window menu or workspace restoration.

capabilities.title: Offline Help and About workflows
capabilities.acceptance: Open bundled offline help, shortcuts, format/limit documentation, diagnostics, licenses, and About.

capabilities.title: Layers panel
capabilities.acceptance: Operate and keyboard-navigate the complete nested layer tree with accessible state and multi-select.
capabilities.limits: Flat single-selection panel; accessibility and large-tree tests missing.

capabilities.title: Color and swatches panels
capabilities.acceptance: Edit foreground/background colors and manage searchable local swatch libraries.

capabilities.title: Brushes panel
capabilities.acceptance: Browse, search, organize, preview, import/export, and reset brush presets.

capabilities.title: Tool options panel
capabilities.acceptance: Expose accessible validated options for every active tool and persist intended defaults.

capabilities.title: Actions panel
capabilities.acceptance: Record, edit, organize, play, stop, and diagnose local actions.

capabilities.title: Paths panel
capabilities.acceptance: Create, name, duplicate, combine, select, stroke/fill, and convert paths.

capabilities.title: Animation/video timeline panel
capabilities.acceptance: Navigate frames/tracks, set timing, preview, and control bounded media caches.
capabilities.budget: Responsive scrub with bounded frame cache

capabilities.title: Pixel layer create, duplicate, reorder, rename, visibility, opacity, and lock
capabilities.acceptance: Perform each operation through undoable UI commands and persist it.
capabilities.limits: UI integration, multi-select, and goldens incomplete.

capabilities.title: Merge down and flatten
capabilities.acceptance: Preserve composite, honor locks, undo, save, and compare goldens.
capabilities.limits: No golden fixtures, groups, masks, or non-source-over modes.

capabilities.title: Nested layer groups
capabilities.acceptance: Create nested groups, reorder trees, isolate, merge, persist, and undo.

capabilities.title: Multi-layer selection and operations
capabilities.acceptance: Select ranges/disjoint layers and apply move, visibility, duplicate, and delete atomically.

capabilities.title: Finite validated opacity
capabilities.acceptance: Reject NaN/infinite opacity at setter, load, and save boundaries.

capabilities.title: Layer pixel-size invariant
capabilities.acceptance: Reject replacement pixels whose dimensions differ from the document.
capabilities.limits: All layers currently match canvas dimensions.

capabilities.title: Raster layer masks
capabilities.acceptance: Create/edit/disable/apply masks with channels, undo, persistence, and goldens.

capabilities.title: Vector masks
capabilities.acceptance: Attach editable paths as nondestructive masks and rasterize deterministically.

capabilities.title: Channels panel and alpha channels
capabilities.acceptance: Inspect, create, edit, load, save, and combine local channels.

capabilities.title: Rectangle selection
capabilities.acceptance: Drag rectangle, replace coverage, show overlay, undo, persist, and avoid identical no-ops.
capabilities.limits: No feathering, handles, or golden overlay fixture.

capabilities.title: Select all, deselect, and invert
capabilities.acceptance: Run commands sparsely with undo/persistence and no-op saved-state semantics.
capabilities.limits: Invert is not exposed with full integration evidence.

capabilities.title: Ellipse, lasso, and polygon selections
capabilities.acceptance: Create antialiased geometric/freehand coverage with combine modes and goldens.

capabilities.title: Color range and magic wand
capabilities.acceptance: Select by tolerance/contiguity with deterministic color-distance fixtures.

capabilities.title: Feather, grow, shrink, and border
capabilities.acceptance: Transform coverage with explicit edge policy, undo, and golden masks.
capabilities.budget: Bounded halo and scratch per tile

capabilities.title: Selection edge refinement
capabilities.acceptance: Preview and commit edge-aware radius, smoothing, feather, contrast, decontamination, and output-to-mask workflows against public fixtures.
capabilities.budget: Cancelable bounded halo, preview cache, and scratch
capabilities.limits: Not implemented; algorithm/dependency choice requires review if consequential.

capabilities.title: Local non-generative subject selection
capabilities.acceptance: Use an approved deterministic/non-generative local algorithm with disclosed limits and fixtures.
capabilities.limits: No model or consequential dependency may be adopted without approval.

capabilities.title: Local non-generative object selection
capabilities.acceptance: Select a user-indicated object locally with reversible mask output and disclosed failure cases.
capabilities.budget: Cancelable with explicit pixel, memory, and time caps
capabilities.limits: Distinct from whole-subject selection; no model may be adopted without approval.

capabilities.title: Local non-generative person selection
capabilities.acceptance: Select people locally across documented poses and occlusions with reversible mask output and bias/accuracy notes.
capabilities.budget: Cancelable with explicit pixel, memory, and time caps
capabilities.limits: Distinct acceptance and fixtures from generic subject/object selection.

capabilities.title: Local background removal
capabilities.acceptance: Create a reversible mask locally from an approved non-generative selection path.
capabilities.limits: No cloud call or generative model.

capabilities.title: Deterministic patch-based removal
capabilities.acceptance: Fill a selection using a documented local patch algorithm with seed-stable goldens.
capabilities.limits: Not generative fill; quality scope must be documented.

capabilities.title: Brush, pencil, and eraser
capabilities.acceptance: Paint deterministic strokes with spacing, opacity, undo coalescing, persistence, and goldens.

capabilities.title: Tablet pressure, tilt, rotation, and smoothing
capabilities.acceptance: Validate supported Wayland tablet axes and deterministic dynamics curves.
capabilities.budget: No dropped input at 240 Hz target

capabilities.title: Tool options and brush presets panels
capabilities.acceptance: Create, edit, import/export, search, and reset local presets.

capabilities.title: Gradient, fill, and color picker
capabilities.acceptance: Apply deterministic fills/gradients and sample merged or active pixels with undo/goldens.

capabilities.title: Move and crop tools
capabilities.acceptance: Move selected pixels/layers and crop nondestructively or destructively by explicit choice.

capabilities.title: Free, perspective, and warp transforms
capabilities.acceptance: Preview, commit, cancel, undo, persist, and compare resampling goldens.
capabilities.budget: Cancelable tile jobs; preview cache bounded

capabilities.title: Clone, heal, and patch tools
capabilities.acceptance: Use explicit local sources with aligned sampling, undo, and deterministic goldens.

capabilities.title: Dodge, burn, and saturation brush
capabilities.acceptance: Apply bounded tonal strokes with range controls and golden fixtures.

capabilities.title: Blur, sharpen, and smudge tools
capabilities.acceptance: Apply halo-aware strokes with undo, persistence, and edge goldens.

capabilities.title: Noise, dust, and scratch restoration
capabilities.acceptance: Apply deterministic local denoise and dust/scratch repair with before/after public fixtures, preview, cancel, undo, and persistence.
capabilities.budget: Cancelable tile jobs with bounded halo/cache/scratch

capabilities.title: Documented blend modes
capabilities.acceptance: Match public formulas on integer/float fixtures in CPU reference rendering.

capabilities.title: Clipping masks
capabilities.acceptance: Clip layer groups deterministically with undo, persistence, and goldens.

capabilities.title: Adjustment layers and properties panel
capabilities.acceptance: Provide levels, curves, exposure, color, and LUT nodes with CPU goldens.

capabilities.title: Layer effects
capabilities.acceptance: Render documented shadows, glows, strokes, and overlays nondestructively.

capabilities.title: Nondestructive filter graph
capabilities.acceptance: Stack, reorder, mask, disable, serialize, and cancel deterministic filters.

capabilities.title: Linked and embedded source layers
capabilities.acceptance: Embed/relink/update local assets and handle missing sources safely.
capabilities.budget: Embedded payload streamed; links never auto-upload

capabilities.title: Panorama alignment and stitching
capabilities.acceptance: Align, seam, blend, crop, cancel, and reopen panoramas using original/public local fixture sets.
capabilities.budget: Bounded pyramid, feature count, memory, scratch, output pixels, and time
capabilities.limits: Not implemented; consequential dependencies require approval.

capabilities.title: HDR merge and tone mapping
capabilities.acceptance: Align and merge bracketed local exposures, remove documented ghosts, tone-map nondestructively, and round-trip high-depth output.
capabilities.budget: Cancelable bounded frame count, pixels, cache, scratch, and time
capabilities.limits: Not implemented; current RGBA8 engine cannot preserve HDR data.

capabilities.title: Focus stacking
capabilities.acceptance: Align and combine a bounded local focus bracket with editable masks and public edge/detail goldens.
capabilities.budget: Cancelable bounded frame count, pyramid, memory, scratch, and output pixels
capabilities.limits: Not implemented; consequential dependencies require approval.

capabilities.title: Paths and pen tool
capabilities.acceptance: Create/edit/convert paths and persist precise geometry.

capabilities.title: Shapes, boolean operations, and SVG interchange
capabilities.acceptance: Create styled shapes, combine paths, and round-trip supported SVG subsets.
capabilities.limits: SVG compatibility subset must be documented.

capabilities.title: Horizontal OpenType text
capabilities.acceptance: Shape editable local text with font fallback and deterministic layout fixtures.
capabilities.limits: Font availability affects rendering and must be recorded.

capabilities.title: RTL, vertical, variable, and path text
capabilities.acceptance: Lay out complex scripts, vertical text, variable axes, and text on paths.

capabilities.title: History, properties, histogram, and info panels
capabilities.acceptance: Expose synchronized local state with keyboard access and bounded updates.

capabilities.title: Native v1 load and v2 round trip
capabilities.acceptance: Round-trip layers/selection in v2, load v1, and reject corrupt/truncated/nonfinite and aggregate-budget hostile input.
capabilities.budget: 1-GiB file, 2,048 stored tiles, 512-MiB aggregate compressed and decoded tile payload caps
capabilities.limits: Synchronous in-process load has no cancellation/wall timeout/helper isolation; no groups, streaming chunks, or recovery journal.

capabilities.title: Raster import pre-decode bounds
capabilities.acceptance: Reject missing, oversized-file, invalid-dimension, oversized-header, and damaged raster inputs before unsafe document allocation.
capabilities.budget: 512-MiB file, 64-MiPixel and 256-MiB decoded RGBA caps before decode
capabilities.limits: Qt decode remains synchronous/in-process without application cancellation, wall timeout, or codec helper isolation.

capabilities.title: Atomic save and source preservation
capabilities.acceptance: Write through atomic replacement and never mutate imported source files.
capabilities.limits: Failure injection, source-byte preservation, and power-loss evidence missing.

capabilities.title: PNG import/export
capabilities.acceptance: Round-trip representative depth/alpha/profile/metadata fixtures and oversized streams.
capabilities.limits: No golden corpus, metadata controls, or streaming export.

capabilities.title: JPEG import/export
capabilities.acceptance: Decode orientation, control quality, flatten alpha explicitly, and test metadata/profile fixtures.
capabilities.limits: No selective metadata/profile controls or streaming export.

capabilities.title: TIFF import/export
capabilities.acceptance: Round-trip supported compression/depth/alpha/profile variants with goldens.
capabilities.limits: Codec-dependent subset and no streaming export.

capabilities.title: WebP import/export
capabilities.acceptance: Round-trip lossy/lossless alpha and metadata/profile policy fixtures.

capabilities.title: OpenEXR import/export
capabilities.acceptance: Round-trip supported float channels and explicitly reject unsupported channel layouts.
capabilities.limits: Current engine normalizes to RGBA8; direct OpenEXR adoption needs approval.

capabilities.title: Oversized export allocation guard
capabilities.acceptance: Reject exports above 64 MiPixels before full-frame allocation with actionable error.

capabilities.title: Metadata inspect, strip, and selective preserve
capabilities.acceptance: Inspect local metadata and choose safe per-field preservation on export.
capabilities.limits: Current policy strips metadata; consequential dependency needs approval.

capabilities.title: PSD/PSB compatibility adapter
capabilities.acceptance: Import/export a documented public-fixture subset with loss reports.
capabilities.limits: No proprietary code/assets or unsupported parity claim.

capabilities.title: RAW development adapter
capabilities.acceptance: Develop an approved camera subset nondestructively with recorded demosaic/color fixtures.

capabilities.title: HEIF/AVIF import/export
capabilities.acceptance: Document and test an approved still-image subset including depth/profile behavior.

capabilities.title: ICC display, assign, and convert workflows
capabilities.acceptance: Assign/convert profiles and render display transforms against public color fixtures.

capabilities.title: CMYK, Lab, spot, soft-proof, and gamut workflows
capabilities.acceptance: Edit/proof supported spaces with intent/BPC controls and measured fixtures.
capabilities.budget: Deterministic CPU reference; bounded proof cache
capabilities.limits: Not implemented; no proprietary profile fixtures.

capabilities.title: Native print setup and output
capabilities.acceptance: Preview scale/position/color settings and print through local system dialogs.

capabilities.title: PDF proof export
capabilities.acceptance: Export local proof PDFs with page geometry, profiles, fonts, and verification fixtures.
dependencies: PDF backend decision packet if Poppler considered
capabilities.limits: Poppler or other consequential dependency requires approval.

capabilities.title: Actions and macros
capabilities.acceptance: Record/edit/replay deterministic commands with stop/continue failure policy.

capabilities.title: Batch and headless CLI
capabilities.acceptance: Process local file sets headlessly with deterministic exit codes and no prompts.

capabilities.title: Local scripting API
capabilities.acceptance: Run permission-scoped versioned scripts with cancellation and reproducible examples.

capabilities.title: Local native plugin SDK
capabilities.acceptance: Load versioned signed/explicitly trusted plugins with crash isolation policy.
capabilities.limits: Deferred until the data model is stable.

capabilities.title: Frame animation timeline
capabilities.acceptance: Create frame/layer timelines, preview timing, and round-trip local projects.
capabilities.budget: Bounded frame cache and playback prefetch

capabilities.title: Animated GIF and APNG
capabilities.acceptance: Import/export documented animation subsets with timing/disposal goldens.

capabilities.title: Video layers and render export
capabilities.acceptance: Import approved codecs, scrub locally, and render deterministic frame sequences/video.
capabilities.budget: Bounded decode queue and frame cache
capabilities.limits: FFmpeg adoption requires user approval; no codec promises yet.

capabilities.title: Accessible names, roles, focus, and keyboard navigation
capabilities.acceptance: Audit every menu/tool/panel/dialog with screen-reader and keyboard-only workflows.
capabilities.budget: No focus traps; actions reachable without pointer
capabilities.limits: Current UI lacks a complete accessibility audit.

capabilities.title: HiDPI and light/dark theme behavior
capabilities.acceptance: Render at supported scale factors/themes without clipped controls or illegible canvas chrome.
capabilities.limits: Original visuals only; real hardware evidence missing.

capabilities.title: Localization and locale-safe behavior
capabilities.acceptance: Extract original strings, test pseudo-locales/RTL, and keep file formats locale-neutral.

capabilities.title: Corrupt-input fuzzing
capabilities.acceptance: Reject corrupt/truncated native and raster inputs under sanitizers and a maintained corpus.
capabilities.limits: Unit fixtures exist; no fuzzer or corpus CI.

capabilities.title: Low-disk and cancellation safety
capabilities.acceptance: Cancel save/export/jobs and simulate ENOSPC without corrupting sources or leaking scratch.
capabilities.budget: Scratch quota and cleanup hard bounds

capabilities.title: Reproducible AppImage and release artifacts
capabilities.acceptance: Produce pinned reproducible artifacts with signed checksums and install smoke tests.
capabilities.budget: Artifact size budget declared before release

capabilities.title: SBOM, licenses, and security policy
capabilities.acceptance: Generate dependency/license inventory and publish vulnerability reporting/update policy.

capabilities.title: Generative fill and expand
capabilities.acceptance: Confirm product and tests contain no generative fill/expand workflow.

capabilities.title: Text-to-image and partner image models
capabilities.acceptance: Confirm no image-generation model or service is bundled or called.

capabilities.title: Adobe cloud, account, Stock, Express, Firefly, and collaboration
capabilities.acceptance: Confirm no account/cloud integration or vendor service dependency.

capabilities.title: Adobe private APIs, code, UI, icons, strings, layouts, and sample assets
capabilities.acceptance: Review provenance and use only original implementation language and visuals.

capabilities.title: Unsubstantiated Photoshop parity claim
capabilities.acceptance: Allow only stable-ID workflow claims supported by Complete catalog rows.

capabilities.title: Mandatory cloud storage or synchronization
capabilities.acceptance: Confirm local documents remain usable without accounts or network access.
capabilities.limits: Optional future local-network features require separate scope.
